messages:
Aisha Mahmood: Received CirrusData invoice CD-2026-11-77 for $7,850. No PO on invoice and vendor charged CLOUD-OPS instead of ENG-Platform. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/cirrus-cd2026-11-77.pdf :eyes:

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: CirrusData CD-2026-11-77, amount $7,850, vendor_id=CD-990. No PO detected. AP ticket AP-8927 created. Recommended: HOLD pending PO match or approval.

Ravi Singh: This is for the model eval cluster runs on Nov 16-17. We asked for trial credits but it looks like they billed full usage. Eng cost center should be ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602).

Procurement-bot: Potential active PO: PO-ENG-2026-060 has vendor mapping for CirrusData and $10k balance but its line item dates are Nov 20-30, not the 16-17 dates on this invoice. Procurement recommends vendor reissue against PO-ENG-2026-060 or issue credit and re-bill.

Olivia Park: I'll contact vendor AP now. Draft: "Per Redwood policy invoices must reference a valid PO. Please either issue corrected invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-060 with adjusted dates or issue a credit memo so you can re-bill."

Ravi Singh: Uploading usage export to AP-8927: s3://redwood-logs/evals/model/2026-11/11-16-17.csv showing 2.1TB used vs vendor billed 3.0TB. Adding to ticket.

Aisha Mahmood: Holding payment and marking invoice as disputed. If vendor offers only partial credit, we'll escalate to VP Eng (Anika) for approval to accept remainder without PO. Also flag Legal if vendor repeats cancelled PO behavior.

invoices-bot: AP-8927 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor replied offering partial credit $2,400 and to re-bill remainder. Added SLA: vendor expects payment within 4 business days to avoid late fee.

Procurement-bot: Partial credit indicates disputed quantity. Procurement prefers reissue to active PO. If vendor insists, route AP-8927 to finance-approvals for VP sign-off on retro PO `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-015`.

Olivia Park: Sent vendor follow-up asking for a full reissue. CC'd Procurement and Anika. Will escalate in 3 business days if no resolution.

Ravi Singh: Thanks 94 attaching the eval logs to the ticket now.

Aisha Mahmood: Noted. I'll update this thread when AP-8927 progresses or VP signs off. :thumbsup:
